title: Addressable: Regular Expression Denial of Service in templates with certain exploded expressions (CVE-2026-126350)
description: Addressable versions from 2.3.0 (excluding yanked 2.3.0 and 2.3.1) through 2.9.0 contain a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) vulnerability in URI template matching when using the explode (*) modifier with certain operators. This causes catastrophic backtracking on malicious inputs, leading to denial of service by consuming excessive CPU time. The issue is fixed in version 2.9.1. The vulnerability affects Ruby implementations with non-memoizing regex engines such as MRI Ruby before 3.2 and JRuby, but not MRI Ruby 3.2+ or TruffleRuby 40.0. Users only using template expansion or URI parsing without matching are not affected.
